title: Treatment Intensification for HIV Infected Patients With Multi-Drug Resistant Virus
brief_summary: Drug resistance may develop in HIV infected patients who take anti-HIV drugs, but most patients do well if they continue taking them. The purpose of this study is to test the effectiveness of a short, intensified course of anti-HIV drugs for controlling HIV infection in adults who have virus resistant to multiple drugs.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HIV viral load of more than 1000 copies/ml
* On stable antiretroviral therapy
* Have multidrug resistance

Exclusion Criteria:

* Require immunomodulatory drugs
